svg.title: Zeref, the Moonwraith cat dragon
svg.desc: Zeref the Moonwraith cat dragon, a young digital creature: black fur, violet starry slit eyes, crescent mark and moon horns, star-membrane wings, spined smoky tail, gem choker.
